event.description: Use a single untied decoder block at d=14, h=2, ff=20 while retaining learned positions and the autoregressive attention path.
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Retained incumbent is 3528 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: accepted attempt-0006 reduced latent width to d=14 (3528, 99.66%); the subsequent d=12 sweep failed as an optimization failure (7.6% peak validation after 30000 steps); 2 prior family macro-attempts. Hypothesis: the two-block retained model may have depth redundancy, and one full self-attention-plus-feed-forward block may suffice for this fixed-format autoregressive task while retaining the required attention layer. This is a parameterization-preserving depth compression, not a representational change. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative, removing or simplifying only the feed-forward sublayer, because it first establishes whether the entire second computational stage is necessary.
